summary: Strive, Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K reporting operational treasury updates rather than a special situation. During October 5-9, 2026, Strive purchased 3,311 bitcoin at an average price of approximately $84,500 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees, lifting bitcoin held to 32,773 from 29,462. Cash and cash equivalents rose to $310.3 million from $284.7 million. The company also disclosed holdings of 505,000 Strategy Inc. STRC preferred shares worth $50.3 million, along with share-count changes, warrant reductions and SATA preferred growth. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present.
